opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: covers the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland (or with a substantial recent connection to Scotland), entitled to remain in the UK (or asylum seekers), not eligible for government tuition fee funding, and enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution. Household income thresholds apply.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover tuition fees for undergraduate students at Scottish higher education institutions who are from low-income households and ineligible for government tuition fee support. Applications processed on a first-come-first-served basis.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh), ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, and without a prior postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: A scholarship developed in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants, aimed at widening participation in postgraduate plant science study for Scottish students from low-income households.
